D7 Neighborhood Safe Side Streets Meeting Amy, I live on the SE corner of REDACTED. We have lived there for almost 40 years. In recent years we have seen an increase of traffic that is now to the point now of being unsafe for our residents. The city has urged people to get out and walk in their neighborhoods to promote a healthy life style. We try to be a walking community. The McClelland Bike trail is up on block on McClelland and has become very dangerous for all activities. The business owners up on 1300 E have torn out any green spaces for parking. The owners of these businesses and traveling east and west on Ramona on McClelland have to pull out into the intersection to see cars coming. We call parking enforcement all the time ticket these people parking too close to the corners. We have continually called and asked for help. I would take place the traffic is horrible and the more those apartments get filled the more traffic we will have pushed down into our little streets with people going double the speed limit especially north and south on 10th East. We have had several close calls with bicyclists already on that corner. We have tried to call the Police to help but that's only a ticket. We have a stop sign. We have four way stops, but no one stops. We are tired at the cars speeding. We need street speed bumps up and down 10th East. Decreasing the speed won't do a thing. It will be ignored and people will drive just like they are driving now. We are also concerned about our children who live around us and local families that don't care about us and our safety. We have kids biking on Ramona, kids playing on their front lawns, pets...etc. Someone is going to be seriously hurt or killed if we don't take care of this problem. We will all be at the meeting on the 20th of July. Tom Miller has done an outstanding job along with Sarah Woolley. We have tried just about everything and hope that you will seriously consider speed bumps. We would love to hear your thoughts and what you think we might be able to do as a community to help with this issue that Superhorse Developers have dropped in our laps to contend with even more traffic. This is not what we signed up for when we moved there and you were the best candidate for representing us and we haven't been disappointed. We are excited to hear what your thoughts are moving forward. Best Fran Hays Frances Hays
